val acceptContract = Node.contract(accept)("AcceptContract",
  "A person accepts their open invitation to a document or folder: they then have a share of it at the invitation's level, in place of any share of it they had, and the invitation goes. Without an open invitation, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation gives no access until it is accepted, and only while it is open; accepting is what makes the share.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)((lib, t, p, what, result) =>
  result === lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
    lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
      invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what)))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCat, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Cat accepts Ann's invitation, sent a day ago: she may view the plan"),
    expect(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "eight days after it was sent the invitation has lapsed"),
    expect(withCat, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "Bob was not invited"),
    reject(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "a lapsed invitation is never accepted"))

content.idea:
## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

AcceptContract.reason: still holds after InvitationsAreOffers changed: Q7 as its own branch: an invitation is an offer from someone who may edit, gives no access, is taken up only while open, and is cleared within one housekeeping period of lapsing. Its proof uses InvitationsLapseOnTime through IsOpenContract, so the deadline is no longer under the root unused.

content.definition:
val acceptContract = Node.contract(accept)("AcceptContract",
  "A person accepts their open invitation to a document or folder: they then have a share of it at the invitation's level, in place of any share of it they had, and the invitation goes. Without an open invitation, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation gives no access until it is accepted, and only while it is open; accepting is what makes the share.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)((lib, t, p, what, result) =>
  result === lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
    lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
      invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what)))))
  .under(invitationsAreOffers)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCat, now, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "Cat accepts Ann's invitation, sent a day ago: she may view the plan"),
    expect(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "eight days after it was sent the invitation has lapsed"),
    expect(withCat, now, bob, Target.Doc(plan), withCat, "Bob was not invited"),
    reject(withCat, now + 7 * day, cat, Target.Doc(plan), library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares),
      "a lapsed invitation is never accepted"))

AccessContract.reason: Computing access from the person's grantees and the document's places is the efficient reading of Reach and Cover; the root proof shows they agree.

content.statement: A person's access to a document is worked out from their teams and the document's folders: among the shares with them or one of their teams, of the document or one of the folders around it, it is edit if one is an edit share, view if there is any, and none otherwise.
content.why: This is how the service finds the shares that matter without asking every share whether it reaches the person and covers the document: it lists who a share must be with and what it must be of, once each. That this finds exactly the shares the meaning names (Reach, Cover) is what the purpose's proof shows.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams

a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches
them and covers it and the document is not in the trash, and edit it exactly
when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

content.statement: At any moment, a person can view a document exactly when it is not in the trash and they may view it, and edit it exactly when it is not in the trash and they may edit it. Only someone who may edit a document or folder changes whom it is shared with or invited to, or moves, trashes or restores a document; a document is restored only before it is gone. An invitation gives no access, and is accepted only while it is open. Housekeeping removes only what has ended: shares no longer in force, invitations no longer open, documents gone and their shares. A share given for good stays in force, an invitation is open when it is sent, and a document not in the trash is never gone.
content.why: The idea in one statement: the shares in force decide who sees and who changes what (Q1, Q2), the trash hides a document until it is restored (Q8), an invitation is an offer, not a share (Q7), and tidying never takes away anything still in force. The last sentence is all the purpose asks of the lifetimes: without it, nothing ever being in force would meet it. Whether a share is in force, an invitation open or a document gone is left open here: Lifetimes fixes it with the clock below, and this holds whatever it says.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches
them and covers it and the document is not in the trash, and edit it exactly
when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.
content.ideaSection: Who can see and change what

AccessFollowsShares.reason: The purpose unchanged in words; its proof now goes through requests (asks change nothing), transfers (owner's edit share) and the log and outbox carried along.

AccessRequestsAreAsks.reason: Q12: asking gives no access, editors answer, approving a pending request makes the share, housekeeping declines after 7 days and reminds after 48 hours.

content.statement: An access request is a person's ask: asking changes nothing shared, offered or kept, so it gives nobody access; only someone who may edit the document answers it, and approving it, while it is pending, makes the share asked for; and housekeeping declines it within one of its periods of its lapsing, and reminds the owner of it within one of its periods of its being due a reminder.
content.why: Q12: a person who has no access asks for it, and an editor decides. Whether a request is still pending, or due a reminder, is left open here (Lifetimes: 7 days and 48 hours); that housekeeping acts on time is RequestsAnsweredOnTime's, with the clock.

forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    ask(lib, t, p, d, level).shares === lib.shares && ask(lib, t, p, d, level).invitations === lib.invitations &&
      ask(lib, t, p, d, level).documents === lib.documents) &&
    forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
      (approve(lib, t, by, p, d) =!= lib ==>
        (mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.requests.exists(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)))) &&
      (decline(lib, t, by, p, d) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)))) &&
    after(events).library.requests.forall(r => isPending(r, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin) &&
      (r.reminded || !reminderDue(r, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin)))

vocabulary: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
approve: the library after someone asks to approve a person's request
ask: the library after a person asks for access to a document
decline: the library after someone asks to decline a person's request
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
housekeepingWithin: the longest the service goes without a run of housekeeping, in seconds
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
reminderDue: whether the owner is due a reminder of an access request at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds

enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val requestsAreAsks = Node.claim("AccessRequestsAreAsks",
  "An access request is a person's ask: asking changes nothing shared, offered or kept, so it gives nobody access; only someone who may edit the document answers it, and approving it, while it is pending, makes the share asked for; and housekeeping declines it within one of its periods of its lapsing, and reminds the owner of it within one of its periods of its being due a reminder.",
  why = "Q12: a person who has no access asks for it, and an editor decides. Whether a request is still pending, or due a reminder, is left open here (Lifetimes: 7 days and 48 hours); that housekeeping acts on time is RequestsAnsweredOnTime's, with the clock.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
  ask(lib, t, p, d, level).shares === lib.shares && ask(lib, t, p, d, level).invitations === lib.invitations &&
    ask(lib, t, p, d, level).documents === lib.documents) &&
  forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    (approve(lib, t, by, p, d) =!= lib ==>
      (mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.requests.exists(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)))) &&
    (decline(lib, t, by, p, d) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)))) &&
  after(events).library.requests.forall(r => isPending(r, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin) &&
    (r.reminded || !reminderDue(r, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Access requests

Anyone named in the library can ask for view or edit on a document. Asking
gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

vocabulary: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
approve: the library after someone asks to approve a person's request
ask: the library after a person asks for access to a document
decline: the library after someone asks to decline a person's request
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
housekeepingWithin: the longest the service goes without a run of housekeeping, in seconds
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
reminderDue: whether the owner is due a reminder of an access request at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds
uses: case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
case class PersonId(name: String)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])

enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>

    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>

        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>

    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))

        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

val announceContract = Node.contract(announce)("AnnounceContract",
  "Announcing a change adds, at the end of the outbox, a notice of its entry to each person it tells, as the library before the change says who: the person invited; whoever sent an invitation now accepted; the owner of a document asked for; the person whose request was approved or declined; the new owner of a document. Nothing else changes.",
  why = "Q13: what is notified and to whom. Who sent an invitation, and who owns a document, are read from the library the request was made on.",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((lib, before, r, e, result) => result === lib.copy((outbox = lib.outbox ++ noticesOf(before, r, e))))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges, sharing.audit.Audit.auditTrail, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime,
    sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
  .examples()(
    expect(library, library, catInvitedBy, entry, library.copy(outbox = List(Notice(cat, Subject.Logged(entry)))), "Cat is told of her invitation"),
    expect(library, library, Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), entry, library,
      "a share tells nobody"),
    reject(library, library, catInvitedBy, entry, library, "an invitation is never kept from the person invited"))

content.idea:
## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

      .on[Request.Invite]((_, to, _, _) => List(Notice(to, Subject[Subject.Logged](e))))

content.idea:
## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

val approveContract = Node.contract(approve)("ApproveContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document approves a person's pending request for it: the person then has a share of it at the level asked, for good, in place of any share of it they had, and the request goes. Otherwise nothing changes.",
  why = "Q12: approving makes the share; a request that has lapsed can no longer be approved, the person asks again.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, by, p, d, result) =>
  result === lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
        sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCatAsking, now, ann, cat, plan, library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "Ann approves: Cat may view the plan"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, withCatAsking, "Bob may not edit the plan: the request stays"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now + 7 * day, ann, cat, plan, withCatAsking, "eight days on the request has lapsed"),
    reject(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, library.copy(shares = catViewsPlan :: library.shares), "only an editor approves"))

AuditTrail.reason: Q15: every change logged in the same save; every share held, and so every yes of canView, traceable to the entry that made it.

content.statement: Every change the service makes is recorded in its log, with the request that made it and when, in the same save as the change; so at every moment, every share the library holds was made by a request in the log. A share is never seen before its entry is there, and every yes of canView rests on shares whose making is logged.
content.why: Q15: every change is logged with who, what and when, and every yes of canView is traceable to the log entries of the shares that gave it. Recording the change in the save that makes it is what puts the entry there first (an ordering of the run, assertion 5 of the time design): no moment of the service shows a share whose entry is not already kept. That the log is append-only and kept for a year is the store's (LibraryKept): nothing removes an entry.

    forall((p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
      mayView(after(events).library, after(events).now, p, Target[Target.Doc](d)) ==>

vocabulary: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
covers: whether a share covers a document or a folder: it is a share of it, or of a folder around it
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
mayView: whether a person may view a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
reaches: whether a share reaches a person: it is with them, or with a team they are in
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
reminderDue: whether the owner is due a reminder of an access request at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

Audit.makes = (e: Term[Entry], s: Term[Share]) =>
    e.change
      .on[Change.Made](r => r
        .on[Request.Access]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Share]((_, what, withWhom, level, until) => s === Share(what, withWhom, level, until))
        .on[Request.Unshare]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Move]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Invite]((_, _, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => s.what === what && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Withdraw]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Trash]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Restore]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Ask]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Approve]((_, p, d) => s.what === Target[Target.Doc](d) && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Decline]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Transfer]((_, d, to) => s === Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt])))
      .on[Change.Housekept.type](False)

val auditTrail = Node.claim("AuditTrail",
  "Every change the service makes is recorded in its log, with the request that made it and when, in the same save as the change; so at every moment, every share the library holds was made by a request in the log. A share is never seen before its entry is there, and every yes of canView rests on shares whose making is logged.",
  why = "Q15: every change is logged with who, what and when, and every yes of canView is traceable to the log entries of the shares that gave it. Recording the change in the save that makes it is what puts the entry there first (an ordering of the run, assertion 5 of the time design): no moment of the service shows a share whose entry is not already kept. That the log is append-only and kept for a year is the store's (LibraryKept): nothing removes an entry.",
  idea = "Audit"
)(after(events).library.shares.forall(s => after(events).library.log.exists(e => makes(e, s))) &&
  forall((p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayView(after(events).library, after(events).now, p, Target[Target.Doc](d)) ==>
      after(events).library.shares.exists(s => inForce(s, after(events).now) && reaches(after(events).library, s, p) &&
        covers(after(events).library, s, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && after(events).library.log.exists(e => makes(e, s)))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Audit

Every change is logged with who asked, what and when, in the same save as the
change, so no change is seen before its entry. Every yes of "can view" can be
traced to the log entries of the shares that gave it. The log only grows.

AuditTrail.reason: Unchanged statement; Lean proves it again: only ShareContract and the ownership branch, which it rests on or sits beside, changed.

That the log is append-only and kept for a year is the store's (LibraryKept): nothing removes an entry.

vocabulary: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
covers: whether a share covers a document or a folder: it is a share of it, or of a folder around it
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
mayView: whether a person may view a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
reaches: whether a share reaches a person: it is with them, or with a team they are in
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
reminderDue: whether the owner is due a reminder of an access request at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds
uses: case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
case class PersonId(name: String)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class TeamId(name: String)
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)
enum Change: case Made(request: Request), case Housekept
case class Entry(id: Int, at: BigInt, change: Change)
enum Subject: case Logged(entry: Entry), case Reminder(request: AccessRequest), case Lapsed(request: AccessRequest)
case class Notice(to: PersonId, about: Subject)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what) && !ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

Audit.makes = (e: Term[Entry], s: Term[Share]) =>
    e.change
      .on[Change.Made](r => r
        .on[Request.Access]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Share]((_, what, withWhom, level, until) => s === Share(what, withWhom, level, until))
        .on[Request.Unshare]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Move]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Invite]((_, _, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => s.what === what && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Withdraw]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Trash]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Restore]((_, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Ask]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Approve]((_, p, d) => s.what === Target[Target.Doc](d) && s.withWhom === Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) && s.until.isEmpty)
        .on[Request.Decline]((_, _, _) => False)
        .on[Request.Transfer]((_, d, to) => s === Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt])))
      .on[Change.Housekept.type](False)

  "Every change the service makes is recorded in its log, with the request that made it and when, in the same save as the change; so at every moment, every share the library holds was made by a request in the log. content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches
them and covers it and the document is not in the trash, and edit it exactly
when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))
content.definition:
val chaseContract = Node.contract(chase)("ChaseContract",
  "Housekeeping chases the access requests at a moment: a request no longer pending is declined (it goes, and the person is told); a pending one due a reminder, not reminded yet, is marked reminded and its document's owner is told. Everything else stays as it was.",
  why = "Q12: a reminder after 48 hours, once; declined automatically after 7 days. The notices go to the outbox with the change, so they are sent once it is saved (Q13).",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, result) =>
  result === lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)),
    outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t))))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCatAsking, now, withCatAsking, "asked a day ago: nothing to do"),
    expect(library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo)), now,
      library.copy(requests = List(catAskedLongAgo.copy(reminded = true)), outbox = List(Notice(ann, Subject.Reminder(catAskedLongAgo)))),
      "asked three days ago: Ann, the plan's owner, is reminded"),

now = do
    let c ← get
    pure c.now

sleep = fun (seconds : Int) => do

content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

ClockNeverGoesBack.reason: Q9: the server's clock never goes back; a clock set back by hand would break it, and it is stated so.

content.statement: Time never goes back between the service's events: each wait is of no time or more.
content.why: Q9: the server's clock never goes back. A clock set back (by hand, or by a time server) would break this; the server reads the clock once per request, so it would answer as if earlier.

val clockNeverGoesBack = Node.assumption("ClockNeverGoesBack",
  "Time never goes back between the service's events: each wait is of no time or more.",
  why = "Q9: the server's clock never goes back. A clock set back (by hand, or by a time server) would break this; the server reads the clock once per request, so it would answer as if earlier.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)(forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => forall((e: Term[Event]) =>
  (events === pre ++ (e :: post)) ==>
    e.on[Event.Asked](_ => True).on[Event.Housekept.type](True).on[Event.Delivered.type](True).on[Event.Waited](d => d >= 0))))
  .under(Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime, Deadlines.endedStaysEnded, Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

val declineContract = Node.contract(decline)("DeclineContract",
  "Someone who may edit a document declines a person's request for it: the request goes. When anyone else asks, nothing changes.",
  why = "Q12: an editor may say no; the person may ask again.",
  idea = "Access requests"
)((lib, t, by, p, d, result) =>
  result === mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))
  .under(requestsAreAsks)
  .examples()(
    expect(withCatAsking, now, ann, cat, plan, library, "Ann declines Cat's request"),
    expect(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, withCatAsking, "Bob may not edit the plan: the request stays"),
    reject(withCatAsking, now, bob, cat, plan, library, "only an editor declines"))

content.idea:
## Access requests

Anyone named in the library can ask for view or edit on a document. Asking
gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

content.idea:
## Access requests

Anyone named in the library can ask for view or edit on a document. Asking
gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

DeliveryJob.reason: Q13/Q16: three tries, 1 s then 2 s apart; a failed run leaves the outbox as it was, proven for every pattern of mailer and store faults.

content.statement: A run of delivery sends the oldest notice in the outbox to the mail server, trying three times, a second and then two seconds apart; once the mail server has it, it leaves the outbox. A run that fails leaves the outbox as it was, so the notice is sent again at the next run. Nothing else in the library changes.
content.why: Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule. A notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice.

val deliveryJob = Node.contract(deliver)("DeliveryJob",
  "A run of delivery sends the oldest notice in the outbox to the mail server, trying three times, a second and then two seconds apart; once the mail server has it, it leaves the outbox. A run that fails leaves the outbox as it was, so the notice is sent again at the next run. Nothing else in the library changes.",
  why = "Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule. A notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice.",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((result, before, after) =>
  before(LibraryModel).outbox.take(1).forall(n => after(MailerModel).contains(n) &&
    after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel).copy((outbox = before(LibraryModel).outbox.filterNot(m => m === n)))) &&
  (before(LibraryModel).outbox.isEmpty ==> (after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))))
  .onFailure[Failure]((e, before, after) => after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(List(told), Nil), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "Cat's notice delivered"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true), (), at(Nil, List(told), now + 1), "the mail server was down once: delivered a second later"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(List(told), Nil, now + 3),
      "down three times: the notice stays in the outbox"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(List(told), List(told)),
      "delivered, but the store failed: the notice stays, to be sent again (and dropped by the mail server)"),
    expect(at(List(told), List(told)), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "sent again after that: not delivered twice"),
    reject(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(Nil, Nil, now + 3),
      "a notice never leaves the outbox undelivered"))

deliveryJob_run = () => Notifications.delivery
deliveryJob = do
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    for n in (List.take (Int.toNat 1) lib.outbox) do
      tryCatchThe Failure (do
          Mailer.send n)
        (fun _ => do
          Clock.sleep 1
          tryCatchThe Failure (do
              Mailer.send n)
            (fun _ => do
              Clock.sleep 2
              Mailer.send n))
      let l ← LibraryStore.load
      LibraryStore.save { l with outbox := (List.filter (fun m => decide (¬(m = n))) l.outbox) }
content.idea:
## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

content.definition:
val deliveryJob = Node.contract(deliver)("DeliveryJob",
  "A run of delivery sends the oldest notice in the outbox to the mail server, trying three times, a second and then two seconds apart; once the mail server has it, it leaves the outbox. A run that fails leaves the outbox as it was, so the notice is sent again at the next run. Nothing else in the library changes.",
  why = "Q13: at least once, through an outbox, retried with a schedule. A notice the mail server took whose removal from the outbox then failed is sent again and dropped by the mail server (MailerKept): never twice.",
  idea = "Notifications"
)((result, before, after) =>
  before(LibraryModel).outbox.take(1).forall(n => after(MailerModel).contains(n) &&
    after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel).copy((outbox = before(LibraryModel).outbox.filterNot(m => m === n)))) &&
  (before(LibraryModel).outbox.isEmpty ==> (after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))))
  .onFailure[Failure]((e, before, after) => after(LibraryModel) === before(LibraryModel))
  .under(noticesFollowChanges)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(List(told), Nil), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "Cat's notice delivered"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true), (), at(Nil, List(told), now + 1), "the mail server was down once: delivered a second later"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(List(told), Nil, now + 3),
      "down three times: the notice stays in the outbox"),
    expect(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(List(told), List(told)),
      "delivered, but the store failed: the notice stays, to be sent again (and dropped by the mail server)"),
    expect(at(List(told), List(told)), (), at(Nil, List(told)), "sent again after that: not delivered twice"),
    reject(at(List(told), Nil).failing(false, true, true, true), Failed(Failure.MailerUnavailable), at(Nil, Nil, now + 3),
      "a notice never leaves the outbox undelivered"))

deliveryJob_run = () => Notifications.delivery
deliveryJob = do
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    for n in (List.take (Int.toNat 1) lib.outbox) do
      tryCatchThe Failure (do
          Mailer.send n)
        (fun _ => do
          Clock.sleep 1
          tryCatchThe Failure (do
              Mailer.send n)
            (fun _ => do
              Clock.sleep 2
              Mailer.send n))
      let l ← LibraryStore.load
      LibraryStore.save { l with outbox := (List.filter (fun m => decide (¬(m = n))) l.outbox) }
content.idea:
## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

EndedStaysEnded.reason: Stability in time: ended, lapsed and gone are one-way, given ClockNeverGoesBack.

content.statement: What has ended stays ended: time in the service never goes back, so a share once ended, an invitation once lapsed and a document once gone stay so for the rest of the run.
content.why: Stability in time: these facts change only one way, which is what lets the service cache them and housekeeping remove them for good. It rests on the clock never going back (ClockNeverGoesBack).

sources.formula:
forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => (events === pre ++ post) ==> (after(pre).now <= after(events).now)) &&
    forall((t: Term[BigInt], u: Term[BigInt]) => (t <= u) ==>
      (forall((s: Term[Share]) => !inForce(s, t) ==> !inForce(s, u)) &&
       forall((i: Term[Invitation]) => !isOpen(i, t) ==> !isOpen(i, u)) &&
       forall((doc: Term[Document]) => gone(doc, t) ==> gone(doc, u))))

vocabulary: events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId)
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt])
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = answered(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = Housekeeping.tidyCode(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(

val endedStaysEnded = Node.claim("EndedStaysEnded",
  "What has ended stays ended: time in the service never goes back, so a share once ended, an invitation once lapsed and a document once gone stay so for the rest of the run.",

  forall((t: Term[BigInt], u: Term[BigInt]) => (t <= u) ==>
    (forall((s: Term[Share]) => !inForce(s, t) ==> !inForce(s, u)) &&
     forall((i: Term[Invitation]) => !isOpen(i, t) ==> !isOpen(i, u)) &&
