content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

EndedStaysEnded.reason: still holds after HousekeepingClearsOnlyTheEnded changed: Q6-Q8 as its own branch: tidying removes only what has ended, and ending is for good (EndedStaysEnded), so nothing it removes could count again. Proven by automation.

    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val endedStaysEnded = Node.claim("EndedStaysEnded",
  "What has ended stays ended: time in the service never goes back, so a share once ended, an invitation once lapsed and a document once gone stay so for the rest of the run.",
  why = "Stability in time: these facts change only one way, which is what lets the service cache them and housekeeping remove them for good. It rests on the clock never going back (ClockNeverGoesBack).",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)(forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => (events === pre ++ post) ==> (after(pre).now <= after(events).now)) &&
  forall((t: Term[BigInt], u: Term[BigInt]) => (t <= u) ==>
    (forall((s: Term[Share]) => !inForce(s, t) ==> !inForce(s, u)) &&
     forall((i: Term[Invitation]) => !isOpen(i, t) ==> !isOpen(i, u)) &&
     forall((doc: Term[Document]) => gone(doc, t) ==> gone(doc, u)))))
  .under(Housekeeping.clearsOnlyTheEnded)
content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

EndedStaysEnded.reason: Unchanged statement; Lean proves it again: only ShareContract and the ownership branch, which it rests on or sits beside, changed.

content.statement: What has ended stays ended: time in the service never goes back, so a share once ended, an invitation once lapsed and a document once gone stay so for the rest of the run.
content.why: Stability in time: these facts change only one way, which is what lets the service cache them and housekeeping remove them for good. It rests on the clock never going back (ClockNeverGoesBack).

forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => (events === pre ++ post) ==> (after(pre).now <= after(events).now)) &&
    forall((t: Term[BigInt], u: Term[BigInt]) => (t <= u) ==>
      (forall((s: Term[Share]) => !inForce(s, t) ==> !inForce(s, u)) &&
       forall((i: Term[Invitation]) => !isOpen(i, t) ==> !isOpen(i, u)) &&
       forall((doc: Term[Document]) => gone(doc, t) ==> gone(doc, u))))

vocabulary: announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
reminderDue: whether the owner is due a reminder of an access request at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)
enum Change: case Made(request: Request), case Housekept
case class Entry(id: Int, at: BigInt, change: Change)
enum Subject: case Logged(entry: Entry), case Reminder(request: AccessRequest), case Lapsed(request: AccessRequest)
case class Notice(to: PersonId, about: Subject)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what) && !ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

Sharing.accessCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>

Sharing.strongest = (ss: Term[List[Share]]) =>
    ss.exists(s => s.level === Level.Edit).fold(some(Level.Edit: Term[Level]), ss.isEmpty.fold(none[Level], some(Level.View: Term[Level])))

Sharing.granteesOf = (lib: Term[Library], p: Term[PersonId]) =>
    Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) :: lib.teams.filter(t => t.members.contains(p)).map(t => Grantee[Grantee.Team](t.id))

Sharing.placesOf = (lib: Term[Library], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    Target[Target.Doc](d) :: lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === d).flatMap(doc => doc.folders.map(f => Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

content.idea:
## Expiring shares

A share may be given until a time. From that time on it gives no access,
whether or not housekeeping has removed it yet: access is worked out from the
clock when it is asked. Sharing again replaces the end time.

ExpiredSharesGiveNoAccess.reason: Restated AccessContract with InForceContract: access reads only the shares in force, so this said nothing they do not. Q6 stays in the root (a share in force) and in InForceContract.

enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation])

Sharing.accessCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    val (grantees, places) = (granteesOf(lib, p), placesOf(lib, d))
    inTrash(lib, d).fold(none[Level], strongest(lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && grantees.contains(s.withWhom) && places.contains(s.what))))

Sharing.strongest = (ss: Term[List[Share]]) =>
    ss.exists(s => s.level === Level.Edit).fold(some(Level.Edit: Term[Level]), ss.isEmpty.fold(none[Level], some(Level.View: Term[Level])))

Sharing.granteesOf = (lib: Term[Library], p: Term[PersonId]) =>
    Grantee[Grantee.Person](p) :: lib.teams.filter(t => t.members.contains(p)).map(t => Grantee[Grantee.Team](t.id))

Sharing.placesOf = (lib: Term[Library], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    Target[Target.Doc](d) :: lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === d).flatMap(doc => doc.folders.map(f => Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

val expiredSharesGiveNoAccess = Node.claim("ExpiredSharesGiveNoAccess",
  "A share gives no access from its end on, whether or not housekeeping has removed it: a person's access is what the shares not yet ended give.",
  why = "Q6: access stops at the end time even before the job runs; the meaning reads the clock, the job only tidies. Stated of the service's code for access.",
  idea = "Expiring shares"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
  Sharing.accessCode(lib, t, p, d) ===
    Sharing.accessCode(lib.copy((shares = lib.shares.filter(s => s.until.fold(True)(end => t < end)))), t, p, d)))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Expiring shares

A share may be given until a time. From that time on it gives no access,
whether or not housekeeping has removed it yet: access is worked out from the
clock when it is asked. Sharing again replaces the end time.

content.statement: A request is answered from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as Sharing makes it, and answered done when the asker may make it and refused otherwise.
content.why: This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's terms (LibraryKept). What the answers and changes are is Sharing's (its contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and leaves the one it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.

vocabulary: access: a person's access to a document, as the service works it out
handle: a request handled on the store: the answer, the store left holding the change
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder
move: the library after someone asks to move a document
share: the library after someone asks to share a document or folder
unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId])
enum Answer: case Access(level: Option[Level]), case Done, case Refused
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share])

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level) => Sharing.share(lib, by, what, withWhom, level))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, by, d, into))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, by, d, into)))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as Sharing makes it, and answered done when the asker may make it and refused otherwise.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's terms (LibraryKept). What the answers and changes are is Sharing's (its contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and leaves the one it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.",
  idea = "Who can see and change what"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === afterRequest(before(LibraryModel), r) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), r))

content.idea:
## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

vocabulary: accept: the library after a person asks to accept an invitation
access: a person's access to a document at a moment, as the service works it out
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
handle: a request handled on the store and the clock: the answer, the store left holding the change
invite: the library after someone asks to invite a person
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
move: the library after someone asks to move a document
restore: the library after someone asks to restore a document from the trash
share: the library after someone asks to share a document or folder
trash: the library after someone asks to put a document in the trash
unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation

case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)

enum Answer: case Access(level: Option[Level]), case Done, case Refused

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.",
  idea = "Serving"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === afterRequest(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

vocabulary: accept: the library after a person asks to accept an invitation
access: a person's access to a document at a moment, as the service works it out
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
handle: a request handled on the store and the clock: the answer, the store left holding the change
invite: the library after someone asks to invite a person
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
move: the library after someone asks to move a document
restore: the library after someone asks to restore a document from the trash
share: the library after someone asks to share a document or folder
trash: the library after someone asks to put a document in the trash
unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId)
enum Answer: case Access(level: Option[Level]), case Done, case Refused
case class ClockState(now: BigInt, delays: List[BigInt])
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt])
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation])

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))
content.definition:
val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.",
  idea = "Serving"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === afterRequest(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

handleContract_run = SharingHttp.handleRequest
handleContract = fun (r : Request) => do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((⟦SharingHttp.afterRequest⟧ lib t r) ≠ lib) then
      LibraryStore.save (⟦SharingHttp.afterRequest⟧ lib t r)
      pure ()
    else
      pure ()
    pure (⟦SharingHttp.answerTo⟧ lib t r)
SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))
SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))
Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))
content.idea:
## Serving

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, audit logs and
outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

HandleContract.reason: still holds after HousekeepingClearsOnlyTheEnded changed: Q6-Q8 as its own branch: tidying removes only what has ended, and ending is for good (EndedStaysEnded), so nothing it removes could count again. Proven by automation.

unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId)
enum Answer: case Access(level: Option[Level]), case Done, case Refused
case class ClockState(now: BigInt, delays: List[BigInt])
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt])
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation])

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))
content.definition:
val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change.",
  idea = "Serving"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === afterRequest(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

handleContract = fun (r : Request) => do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((⟦SharingHttp.afterRequest⟧ lib t r) ≠ lib) then
      LibraryStore.save (⟦SharingHttp.afterRequest⟧ lib t r)
      pure ()
    else
      pure ()
    pure (⟦SharingHttp.answerTo⟧ lib t r)

content.idea:
## Serving

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, audit logs and
outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

HandleContract.reason: Q15/Q16: a change is recorded and announced in the same save as it; a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of faults.

content.statement: A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, recorded in the log and announced in the outbox in the same save, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.
content.why: This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change. One save per request is one transaction: Q16, a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of the store's failures; the server answers it 503 (ServerWiring).

vocabulary: accept: the library after a person asks to accept an invitation
access: a person's access to a document at a moment, as the service works it out
announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
approve: the library after someone asks to approve a person's request
ask: the library after a person asks for access to a document
decline: the library after someone asks to decline a person's request
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
handle: a request handled on the store and the clock: the answer, the store left holding the change
invite: the library after someone asks to invite a person
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
move: the library after someone asks to move a document
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
restore: the library after someone asks to restore a document from the trash
share: the library after someone asks to share a document or folder
transfer: the library after someone asks to hand a document on
trash: the library after someone asks to put a document in the trash
unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation

      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.ask(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approve(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.decline(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transfer(lib, t, by, d, to))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, d, _) => allowedWhen(lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        lib.requests.exists(q => q.person === p && q.doc === d && isPending(q, t))))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, _, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => allowedWhen(Ownership.owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, recorded in the log and announced in the outbox in the same save, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change. One save per request is one transaction: Q16, a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of the store's failures; the server answers it 503 (ServerWiring).",
  idea = "Failures"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === served(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share, and its entry in the log"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(library),
      "the store fails as the share is saved: nothing changes"),
    reject(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(bobViewsPlan),
      "a request the store fails is never half kept"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

handleContract = fun (r : Request) => do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load

      LibraryStore.save (⟦SharingHttp.served⟧ lib t r)
      pure ()

content.idea:
## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

vocabulary: accept: the library after a person asks to accept an invitation
access: a person's access to a document at a moment, as the service works it out
announce: the library with notices of a change added to its outbox
approve: the library after someone asks to approve a person's request
ask: the library after a person asks for access to a document
decline: the library after someone asks to decline a person's request
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
handle: a request handled on the store and the clock: the answer, the store left holding the change
invite: the library after someone asks to invite a person
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
move: the library after someone asks to move a document
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document
record: the library with a change recorded in its log
restore: the library after someone asks to restore a document from the trash
share: the library after someone asks to share a document or folder
transfer: the library after someone asks to hand a document on
trash: the library after someone asks to put a document in the trash
unshare: the library after someone asks to unshare a document or folder
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation
uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)
enum Answer: case Access(level: Option[Level]), case Done, case Refused
case class ClockState(now: BigInt, delays: List[BigInt])
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)
enum Change: case Made(request: Request), case Housekept
case class Entry(id: Int, at: BigInt, change: Change)
enum Subject: case Logged(entry: Entry), case Reminder(request: AccessRequest), case Lapsed(request: AccessRequest)
case class Notice(to: PersonId, about: Subject)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.ask(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approve(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.decline(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transfer(lib, t, by, d, to))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, _, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, d, _) => allowedWhen(lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        lib.requests.exists(q => q.person === p && q.doc === d && isPending(q, t))))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, _, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => allowedWhen(Ownership.owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, recorded in the log and announced in the outbox in the same save, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change. One save per request is one transaction: Q16, a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of the store's failures; the server answers it 503 (ServerWiring).",
  idea = "Failures"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === served(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share, and its entry in the log"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(library),
      "the store fails as the share is saved: nothing changes"),
    reject(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(bobViewsPlan),
      "a request the store fails is never half kept"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

handleContract_run = SharingHttp.handleRequest
handleContract = fun (r : Request) => do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((⟦SharingHttp.served⟧ lib t r) ≠ lib) then
      LibraryStore.save (⟦SharingHttp.served⟧ lib t r)
      pure ()
    else
      pure ()
    pure (⟦SharingHttp.answerTo⟧ lib t r)

    let(afterRequest(lib, t, r))(next => (next =!= lib).fold(
      Notifications.announce(Audit.record(next, t, Change[Change.Made](r)), lib, r, Entry(next.log.length, t, Change[Change.Made](r))), lib))

      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))

      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, d, _) => allowedWhen(lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        lib.requests.exists(q => q.person === p && q.doc === d && isPending(q, t))))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, _, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => allowedWhen(Ownership.owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))
Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)
content.idea:
## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

HandleContract.reason: Lean proves it again; a share with the owner of their own document is answered refused, as an unshare of it is.

Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.

SharingHttp.afterRequest = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.share(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshare(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.move(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.accept(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trash(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restore(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.ask(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approve(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.decline(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transfer(lib, t, by, d, to))

SharingHttp.answerTo = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((p, d) => Answer[Answer.Access](Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, _, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => allowedWhen(Sharing.mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into)))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, _, what, _) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => allowedWhen(lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, _, what) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => allowedWhen(Trash.mayRestore(lib, t, by, d)))
      .on[Request.Ask]((_, d, _) => allowedWhen(lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d)))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        lib.requests.exists(q => q.person === p && q.doc === d && isPending(q, t))))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, _, d) => allowedWhen(mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d))))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => allowedWhen(Ownership.owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
        mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))))

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

val handleContract = Node.contract(handle)("HandleContract",
  "A request is answered at the time the clock gives, from the library the store holds, and leaves the store holding the library it leads to: a question is answered with the person's access and changes nothing; a change is made as its operation makes it, recorded in the log and announced in the outbox in the same save, and answered done when it may be made and refused otherwise. Handling does not move the clock. A request the store fails changes nothing.",
  why = "This is the service as a client sees it, in the store's and the clock's terms (LibraryKept, ClockKept). What the answers and changes are is the operations' (their contracts); what this adds is that each request reads the library the last one left and the clock once, and leaves the library it leads to, so a client's next request sees its change. One save per request is one transaction: Q16, a store failure mid-request changes nothing, proven for every pattern of the store's failures; the server answers it 503 (ServerWiring).",
  idea = "Failures"
)((r, result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === served(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel) && result === answerTo(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now, r))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
  .examples()(
    expect(Request.Access(bob, q3Report), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Bob's team may view the reports folder: Bob can view the Q3 report, and nothing changes"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(bobViewsPlan), "Ann shares the plan with Bob: the store holds the new share, and its entry in the log"),
    expect(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(library),
      "the store fails as the share is saved: nothing changes"),
    reject(shareWithBob, at(library).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(bobViewsPlan),
      "a request the store fails is never half kept"),
    expect(Request.Share(bob, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.Edit, None), at(library), Answer.Refused,
      at(library), "Bob may not edit the plan: refused, and the store keeps the library"),
    reject(Request.Share(ann, Target.Doc(plan), Grantee.Person(bob), Level.View, None), at(library), Answer.Done,
      at(library), "a change answered done is kept"),
    reject(Request.Access(cat, plan), at(library), Answer.Access(Some(Level.View)), at(library),
      "Cat has no access to the plan"))

handleContract = fun (r : Request) => do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((⟦SharingHttp.served⟧ lib t r) ≠ lib) then
      LibraryStore.save (⟦SharingHttp.served⟧ lib t r)
      pure ()
    else
      pure ()
    pure (⟦SharingHttp.answerTo⟧ lib t r)

content.idea:
## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

HousekeepingClearsOnlyTheEnded.reason: Q6-Q8 as its own branch: tidying removes only what has ended, and ending is for good (EndedStaysEnded), so nothing it removes could count again. Proven by automation.

content.statement: Housekeeping clears away only what has ended: shares no longer in force or of a document gone, invitations no longer open, and documents gone; and what has ended stays ended, so nothing it clears could have counted again.
content.why: Q6-Q8: tidying keeps the library from growing with what gives nothing; it is safe because ending is for good. Whether something has ended is left open here (Lifetimes); that it stays ended rests on the clock never going back (EndedStaysEnded).

content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

HousekeepingClearsOnlyTheEnded.reason: Unchanged statement; housekeeping now also chases requests, which removes no share, invitation or document.

val clearsOnlyTheEnded = Node.claim("HousekeepingClearsOnlyTheEnded",
  "Housekeeping clears away only what has ended: shares no longer in force or of a document gone, invitations no longer open, and documents gone; and what has ended stays ended, so nothing it clears could have counted again.",
  why = "Q6-Q8: tidying keeps the library from growing with what gives nothing; it is safe because ending is for good. Whether something has ended is left open here (Lifetimes); that it stays ended rests on the clock never going back (EndedStaysEnded).",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
  lib.shares.forall(s => tidy(lib, t).shares.contains(s) || !inForce(s, t) ||
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))) &&
  lib.invitations.forall(i => tidy(lib, t).invitations.contains(i) || !isOpen(i, t)) &&
  lib.documents.forall(doc => tidy(lib, t).documents.contains(doc) || gone(doc, t))) &&
  forall((t: Term[BigInt], u: Term[BigInt]) => (t <= u) ==>
    (forall((s: Term[Share]) => !inForce(s, t) ==> !inForce(s, u)) &&
     forall((i: Term[Invitation]) => !isOpen(i, t) ==> !isOpen(i, u)) &&
     forall((doc: Term[Document]) => gone(doc, t) ==> gone(doc, u)))))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

HousekeepingJob.reason: The job's flow on the store and the clock, proven: it saves the library tidied at the clock's time.

content.statement: A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied at the time the clock gives; it does not move the clock.
content.why: The job is how tidying reaches the store. Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept); how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime).
