val jobContract = Node.contract(housekeep)("HousekeepingJob",
  "A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied at the time the clock gives; it does not move the clock.",
  why = "The job is how tidying reaches the store. Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept); how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime).",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((result, before, after) =>
  after(LibraryModel) === tidy(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel))
  .under(sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime)
  .examples()(
    expect(World(LibraryModel -> ended, ClockModel -> ClockState(now + 3600, Nil)), (),
      World(LibraryModel -> ended.copy(shares = library.shares), ClockModel -> ClockState(now + 3600, Nil)), "an hour on: Bob's share goes"),
    expect(World(LibraryModel -> ended, ClockModel -> ClockState(now, Nil)), (),
      World(LibraryModel -> ended, ClockModel -> ClockState(now, Nil)), "nothing has ended yet"),
    reject(World(LibraryModel -> ended, ClockModel -> ClockState(now + 3600, Nil)), (),
      World(LibraryModel -> ended, ClockModel -> ClockState(now + 3600, Nil)), "a run removes what has ended"))

content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

HousekeepingJob.reason: Q16: a failed run changes nothing (proven for every pattern of store faults) and the next minute's run tries again; it now also chases requests and records what it changed.

A run that fails changes nothing, and the next minute's run tries again.
content.why: The job is how tidying and chasing reach the store. Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept), for every pattern of the store's failures; how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime). Q16: a failed run changes nothing until one succeeds.

val jobContract = Node.contract(housekeep)("HousekeepingJob",
  "A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied and its access requests chased at the time the clock gives, and, when that changed it, recorded in the log; it does not move the clock. A run that fails changes nothing, and the next minute's run tries again.",
  why = "The job is how tidying and chasing reach the store. Q16: a failed run changes nothing until one succeeds.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(AccessRequests.chase(tidy(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now))(next =>
    after(LibraryModel) === (next =!= before(LibraryModel)).fold(Audit.record(next, before(ClockModel).now, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]),
      before(LibraryModel))) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600), "an hour on: Bob's share goes, and the run is logged"),
    expect(at(ended, now), (), at(ended, now), "nothing has ended yet: nothing to log"),
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(ended, now + 3600),
      "the store fails as the run saves: nothing changes, the next run tries again"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(ended, now + 3600), "a run removes what has ended"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600),
      "a failed run changes nothing"))

housekeepingJob_run = () => Housekeeping.housekeeping
housekeepingJob = do
    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load
    if ((chase (tidy lib t) t) ≠ lib) then
      LibraryStore.save (record (chase (tidy lib t) t) t Change.Housekept)
      pure ()
    else
      pure ()

val jobContract = Node.contract(housekeep)("HousekeepingJob",
  "A run of housekeeping leaves the store holding the library it held, tidied and its access requests chased at the time the clock gives, and, when that changed it, recorded in the log; it does not move the clock. A run that fails changes nothing, and the next minute's run tries again.",
  why = "The job is how tidying and chasing reach the store. Proven of its flow from the store's and the clock's models (LibraryKept, ClockKept), for every pattern of the store's failures; how often it runs is the scheduler's (HousekeepingOnTime). Q16: a failed run changes nothing until one succeeds.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)((result, before, after) =>
  let(AccessRequests.chase(tidy(before(LibraryModel), before(ClockModel).now), before(ClockModel).now))(next =>
    after(LibraryModel) === (next =!= before(LibraryModel)).fold(Audit.record(next, before(ClockModel).now, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]),
      before(LibraryModel))) && after(ClockModel) === before(ClockModel) &&
    after(MailerModel) === before(MailerModel))
  .failsChangingNothing[Failure]
  .under(sharing.time.Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime, sharing.time.Deadlines.requestsAnsweredOnTime)
  .examples()(
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600), "an hour on: Bob's share goes, and the run is logged"),
    expect(at(ended, now), (), at(ended, now), "nothing has ended yet: nothing to log"),
    expect(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(ended, now + 3600),
      "the store fails as the run saves: nothing changes, the next run tries again"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600), (), at(ended, now + 3600), "a run removes what has ended"),
    reject(at(ended, now + 3600).failing(false, true), Failed(Failure.StoreUnavailable), at(tidiedAnHourOn, now + 3600),
      "a failed run changes nothing"))

    let t ← Clock.now
    let lib ← LibraryStore.load

content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

HousekeepingOnTime.reason: The scheduler's promise the deadlines rest on; not proven, checked where the server runs, and the tests show which claims fail without it.

content.statement: Housekeeping runs often enough: time never moves on more than two minutes past its last run.
content.why: The scheduler starts housekeeping every minute (Housekeeping.schedule); this is what the deadlines need of it. Not proven: the server checks it as it runs, and the tests show which claims fail without it.

forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => forall((e: Term[Event]) =>
    (events === pre ++ (e :: post)) ==>
      e.on[Event.Asked](_ => True).on[Event.Housekept.type](True)
        .on[Event.Waited](d => after(pre).now + d <= after(pre).tidied + housekeepingWithin)))

vocabulary: events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
housekeepingWithin: the longest the service goes without a run of housekeeping, in seconds
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds

case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId)
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt])
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = answered(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = Housekeeping.tidyCode(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val housekeepingOnTime = Node.assumption("HousekeepingOnTime",
  "Housekeeping runs often enough: time never moves on more than two minutes past its last run.",
  why = "The scheduler starts housekeeping every minute (Housekeeping.schedule); this is what the deadlines need of it. Not proven: the server checks it as it runs, and the tests show which claims fail without it.",
  idea = "Time and housekeeping"
)(forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => forall((e: Term[Event]) =>
  (events === pre ++ (e :: post)) ==>
    e.on[Event.Asked](_ => True).on[Event.Housekept.type](True)
      .on[Event.Waited](d => after(pre).now + d <= after(pre).tidied + housekeepingWithin))))
  .under(Deadlines.trashPurgedOnTime, Deadlines.invitationsLapseOnTime)
content.idea:
## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

HousekeepingOnTime.reason: Unchanged assumption, now also used by RequestsAnsweredOnTime.

content.statement: Housekeeping runs often enough: time never moves on more than two minutes past its last run.
content.why: The scheduler starts housekeeping every minute (Housekeeping.schedule); this is what the deadlines need of it. A run that fails changes nothing (HousekeepingJob) and is tried again at the next minute (Q16), so this asks for a run that succeeds every two minutes: a store down longer breaks it. Not proven: the server checks it as it runs, and the tests show which claims fail without it.

forall((pre: Term[List[Event]], post: Term[List[Event]]) => forall((e: Term[Event]) =>
    (events === pre ++ (e :: post)) ==>
      e.on[Event.Asked](_ => True).on[Event.Housekept.type](True).on[Event.Delivered.type](True)
        .on[Event.Waited](d => after(pre).now + d <= after(pre).tidied + housekeepingWithin)))

events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
housekeepingWithin: the longest the service goes without a run of housekeeping, in seconds
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
isPending: whether an access request is pending at a moment: it can be approved then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
ownedBy: whether a share of a document or folder with someone is the owner's share of their own document

uses: case class PersonId(name: String)
case class DocumentId(name: String)
case class FolderId(name: String)
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
case class TeamId(name: String)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)
enum Change: case Made(request: Request), case Housekept
case class Entry(id: Int, at: BigInt, change: Change)
enum Subject: case Logged(entry: Entry), case Reminder(request: AccessRequest), case Lapsed(request: AccessRequest)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what) && !ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

content.idea:
# Sharing documents

People keep documents in folders and share them with other people, or with
teams. The shares decide who can view a document and who can edit it, and who
may change whom it is shared with.

From: Q1, Q5

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share reaches them and
covers it, and edit it exactly when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is.

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules, expiring
shares, audit logs and outside identity providers are not part of it yet.

From: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5

# Sharing documents

teams. The shares decide who can view a document and who can edit it, and who
may change whom it is shared with. Shares can end, invitations lapse, and
documents in the trash are deleted for good after a while. People can ask for
access; every document has an owner; every change is logged; people are told
of what concerns them; and a failure leaves things as they were.

From: Q1, Q5

## Who can see and change what

A person can view or edit a document; being able to edit it includes being able
to view it. A share gives one person, or everyone in one team, view or edit on
one document, or on a folder and everything inside it, at any depth. Teams
contain people only. Folders form a tree, and a document is in at most one
folder. A person can view a document exactly when some share in force reaches
them and covers it and the document is not in the trash, and edit it exactly
when such a share is an edit share.

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can share it, or unshare it; sharing
it again with the same person or team changes the level. Moving a document into
a folder needs edit on both. Nobody else changes the shares, or where a
document is. Moving a document out of a folder may take away the mover's own
access, and the last edit share of a document may be unshared.

From: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q10, Q11

## Expiring shares

A share may be given until a time. From that time on it gives no access,
whether or not housekeeping has removed it yet: access is worked out from the
clock when it is asked. Sharing again replaces the end time.

From: Q6

## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

From: Q7

## Trash

Deleting a document puts it in the trash, where it gives nobody access, whatever
its shares. Anyone who can edit it can restore it for 30 days, and its shares
hold again. After 30 days it is gone: it can no longer be restored, and
housekeeping deletes it and its shares for good, never before.

From: Q8

## Time and housekeeping

Time is the server's clock, in seconds, read once for each request: a request
is answered at one moment. Housekeeping runs every minute, one at a time with
the requests; it removes shares that have ended, invitations that have lapsed,
and documents gone from the trash. Nothing waits for it: it only tidies.

From: Q9

## Serving

The service answers these questions and makes these changes over HTTP, keeping
the library in memory or in a SQLite file. Versions, deny rules and outside
identity providers are not part of it yet.

From: Q5

## Access requests

Anyone named in the library can ask for view or edit on a document. Asking
gives no access. Anyone who can edit the document approves the request, which
makes the share asked for, or declines it. A request nobody answers is
reminded of to the document's owner after 48 hours, once, and declined
automatically after 7 days; housekeeping does both.

From: Q12

## Ownership

Every document has exactly one owner. Only the owner, while they can edit it,
hands it on, and only to someone who can edit it; the new owner then has an
edit share of it for good. Nobody can unshare an owner's own share of their
document, so the owner always can edit it, and leaving a team never takes their
documents from them.

From: Q14

## Audit

Every change is logged with who asked, what and when, in the same save as the
change, so no change is seen before its entry. Every yes of "can view" can be
traced to the log entries of the shares that gave it. The log only grows.

From: Q15

## Notifications

Invitations, accepted invitations, access requests and their answers,
reminders, and documents handed on are notified to the person they concern.
Each notice goes to an outbox in the same save as its change, and is sent from
there, retried until the mail server has it: a person is told of each event at
least once and never twice, because the mail server keeps each event once.

From: Q13

## Failures

When the store fails in the middle of a request, the request is answered 503
and changes nothing: each request is one save. A run of housekeeping that fails
changes nothing and is tried again at the next minute; a run of delivery that
fails leaves its notice in the outbox, to be sent again.

From: Q16

expect (Share(Doc(DocumentId("plan")), Person(PersonId("bob")), View, Some(1003600)), 1003600) ⇒ false  given   — at its end it has ended

val inForceContract = Node.contract(inForce)("InForceContract",
  "A share is in force while now is before its end; a share with no end is always in force.",
  why = "Q6: a share may be given until a time; from that time on it gives no access, whether or not housekeeping has removed it yet, because access reads the clock.",
  idea = "Expiring shares"
)((s, t, result) => result === s.until.fold(True)(end => t < end))
  .under(accessFollowsShares, Deadlines.expiredSharesGiveNoAccess, Deadlines.endedStaysEnded)
  .examples()(
    expect(annEditsPlan, now, true, "a share with no end"),
    expect(bobViewsPlanForAnHour, now, true, "an hour before its end"),
    expect(bobViewsPlanForAnHour, now + 3600, false, "at its end it has ended"),
    reject(bobViewsPlanForAnHour, now + 7200, true, "never after its end"))

content.idea:
## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

InvitationsAreOffers.reason: Q7 as its own branch: an invitation is an offer from someone who may edit, gives no access, is taken up only while open, and is cleared within one housekeeping period of lapsing. Its proof uses InvitationsLapseOnTime through IsOpenContract, so the deadline is no longer under the root unused.

content.statement: An invitation is an offer from someone who may edit: only they send it or take it back, it gives nobody access, it is taken up only by the person invited while it is open, and housekeeping clears it away within one of its periods of its lapsing.
content.why: Q7: an invitation is how someone gets a share they have not asked for; it is a share offered, not given, so until it is accepted access is as before. Whether it is open is left open here (Lifetimes); that a lapsed one does not linger is what InvitationsLapseOnTime says with the clock.

sources.formula:
forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    (withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
    forall((level: Term[Level]) => (invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
      forall((p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
        Sharing.access(invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level), t, p, d) === Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))) &&
    forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
      accept(lib, t, p, what) =!= lib ==> lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))) &&
    after(events).library.invitations.forall(i => isOpen(i, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin))

vocabulary: accept: the library after a person asks to accept an invitation
access: a person's access to a document at a moment, as the service works it out
events: what has happened to the service since it started, in order: the requests answered, the runs of housekeeping, and time passing
gone: whether a document is gone at a moment: past restoring, purged by the next housekeeping
housekeepingWithin: the longest the service goes without a run of housekeeping, in seconds
inForce: whether a share is in force at a moment: it gives access then
invite: the library after someone asks to invite a person
isOpen: whether an invitation is open at a moment: it can be accepted then
mayEdit: whether a person may edit a document or folder at a moment
startedAt: when the service started, in seconds
withdraw: the library after someone asks to withdraw an invitation

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = answered(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = Housekeeping.tidyCode(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))

    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val invitationsAreOffers = Node.claim("InvitationsAreOffers",
  "An invitation is an offer from someone who may edit: only they send it or take it back, it gives nobody access, it is taken up only by the person invited while it is open, and housekeeping clears it away within one of its periods of its lapsing.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation is how someone gets a share they have not asked for; it is a share offered, not given, so until it is accepted access is as before. Whether it is open is left open here (Lifetimes); that a lapsed one does not linger is what InvitationsLapseOnTime says with the clock.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
  (withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
  forall((level: Term[Level]) => (invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
    forall((p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
      Sharing.access(invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level), t, p, d) === Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))) &&
  forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    accept(lib, t, p, what) =!= lib ==> lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))) &&
  after(events).library.invitations.forall(i => isOpen(i, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin)))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

InvitationsAreOffers.reason: Unchanged statement; proof redone over the run with recording and announcing in each step.

case class FolderId(name: String)
case class PersonId(name: String)
case class Document(id: DocumentId, title: String, folders: List[FolderId], trashed: Option[BigInt], owner: PersonId)
case class Folder(id: FolderId, name: String, folders: List[FolderId])
case class TeamId(name: String)
case class Team(id: TeamId, members: List[PersonId])
enum Target: case Doc(id: DocumentId), case InFolder(id: FolderId)
enum Grantee: case Person(id: PersonId), case Team(id: TeamId)
enum Level: case View, case Edit
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)

case class Notice(to: PersonId, about: Subject)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

enum Level: case View, case Edit
case class Share(what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Invitation(to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level, by: PersonId, sent: BigInt)
case class AccessRequest(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level, asked: BigInt, reminded: Boolean)

enum Request: case Access(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Share(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee, level: Level, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(by: PersonId, what: Target, withWhom: Grantee), case Move(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, into: Option[FolderId]), case Invite(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target, level: Level), case Accept(person: PersonId, what: Target), case Withdraw(by: PersonId, to: PersonId, what: Target), case Trash(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Restore(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Ask(person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, level: Level), case Approve(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Decline(by: PersonId, person: PersonId, doc: DocumentId), case Transfer(by: PersonId, doc: DocumentId, to: PersonId)
enum Change: case Made(request: Request), case Housekept
case class Entry(id: Int, at: BigInt, change: Change)
enum Subject: case Logged(entry: Entry), case Reminder(request: AccessRequest), case Lapsed(request: AccessRequest)
case class Notice(to: PersonId, about: Subject)

case class Library(documents: List[Document], folders: List[Folder], teams: List[Team], shares: List[Share], invitations: List[Invitation], requests: List[AccessRequest], log: List[Entry], outbox: List[Notice])
case class Moment(library: Library, now: BigInt, tidied: BigInt, mailbox: List[Notice])
enum Event: case Asked(request: Request), case Housekept, case Delivered, case Waited(seconds: BigInt)

Run.after = (es: Term[List[Event]]) =>
    es.foldLeft(Moment(Library(Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil, Nil), startedAt, startedAt, Nil): Term[Moment])((m, e) => step(m, e))

Run.step = (m: Term[Moment], e: Term[Event]) =>
    e.on[Event.Asked](r => m.copy((library = served(m.library, m.now, r))))
      .on[Event.Housekept.type](m.copy((library = housekept(m.library, m.now), tidied = m.now)))
      .on[Event.Delivered.type](m.library.outbox.headOption.fold(m)(n =>
        m.copy((library = m.library.copy((outbox = m.library.outbox.filterNot(x => x === n))),
          mailbox = m.mailbox.contains(n).fold(m.mailbox, m.mailbox ++ List(n))))))
      .on[Event.Waited](d => m.copy((now = m.now + d)))

Run.answered = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], r: Term[Request]) =>
    r.on[Request.Access]((_, _) => lib)
      .on[Request.Share]((by, what, withWhom, level, until) => Sharing.shareCode(lib, t, by, Share(what, withWhom, level, until)))
      .on[Request.Unshare]((by, what, withWhom) => Sharing.unshareCode(lib, t, by, what, withWhom))
      .on[Request.Move]((by, d, into) => Sharing.moveCode(lib, t, by, d, into))
      .on[Request.Invite]((by, to, what, level) => Invitations.inviteCode(lib, t, by, to, what, level))
      .on[Request.Accept]((p, what) => Invitations.acceptCode(lib, t, p, what))
      .on[Request.Withdraw]((by, to, what) => Invitations.withdrawCode(lib, t, by, to, what))
      .on[Request.Trash]((by, d) => Trash.trashCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Restore]((by, d) => Trash.restoreCode(lib, t, by, d))
      .on[Request.Ask]((p, d, level) => AccessRequests.askCode(lib, t, p, d, level))
      .on[Request.Approve]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.approveCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Decline]((by, p, d) => AccessRequests.declineCode(lib, t, by, p, d))
      .on[Request.Transfer]((by, d, to) => Ownership.transferCode(lib, t, by, d, to))

Sharing.shareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], s: Term[Share]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, s.what) && !ownedBy(lib, s.what, s.withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = s :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, s.what, s.withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.sharesWithout = (ss: Term[List[Share]], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    ss.filterNot(s => s.what === what && s.withWhom === withWhom)

Sharing.unshareCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], withWhom: Term[Grantee]) =>
    (mayEdit(lib, t, by, what) && !ownedBy(lib, what, withWhom)).fold(lib.copy((shares = sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, withWhom))), lib)

Sharing.moveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    val placed = foldersAt(lib, into)
    mayMove(lib, t, by, d, into).fold(lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((folders = placed)), doc)))), lib)

Sharing.mayMove = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) &&
      into.fold(True)(f => lib.folders.exists(folder => folder.id === f) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.InFolder](f)))

Sharing.foldersAt = (lib: Term[Library], into: Term[Option[FolderId]]) =>
    into.fold(List.empty[FolderId])(f => lib.folders.find(folder => folder.id === f).fold(List.empty[FolderId])(folder => folder.folders ++ List(f)))

Invitations.inviteCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target], level: Term[Level]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = Invitation(to, what, level, by, t) :: invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Invitations.invitationsWithout = (is: Term[List[Invitation]], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    is.filterNot(i => i.to === to && i.what === what)

Invitations.acceptCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    lib.invitations.find(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t)).fold(lib)(i =>
      lib.copy((shares = Share(what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), i.level, none[BigInt]) :: sharesWithout(lib.shares, what, Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
        invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, p, what))))

Invitations.withdrawCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, what).fold(lib.copy((invitations = invitationsWithout(lib.invitations, to, what))), lib)

Trash.trashCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !doc.trashed.isDefined).fold(doc.copy((trashed = some(t))), doc)))), lib)

Trash.restoreCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayRestore(lib, t, by, d).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d && !gone(doc, t)).fold(doc.copy((trashed = none[BigInt])), doc)))), lib)

Trash.mayRestore = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.trashed.isDefined && !gone(doc, t))

AccessRequests.askCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], level: Term[Level]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d).fold(
      lib.copy((requests = AccessRequest(p, d, level, t, False) :: requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

AccessRequests.requestsWithout = (rs: Term[List[AccessRequest]], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    rs.filterNot(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d)

AccessRequests.approveCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.requests.find(r => r.person === p && r.doc === d && isPending(r, t)).fold(lib)(r =>
      mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(
        lib.copy((shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p), r.level, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](p)),
          requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib))

AccessRequests.declineCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)).fold(lib.copy((requests = requestsWithout(lib.requests, p, d))), lib)

Ownership.transferCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId], to: Term[PersonId]) =>
    (owns(lib, by, d) && mayEdit(lib, t, by, Target[Target.Doc](d)) && mayEdit(lib, t, to, Target[Target.Doc](d))).fold(
      lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.map(doc => (doc.id === d).fold(doc.copy((owner = to)), doc)),
        shares = Share(Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to), Level.Edit, none[BigInt]) ::
          sharesWithout(lib.shares, Target[Target.Doc](d), Grantee[Grantee.Person](to)))), lib)

Ownership.owns = (lib: Term[Library], by: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => doc.id === d && doc.owner === by)

Run.housekept = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    let(AccessRequests.chaseCode(Housekeeping.tidyCode(lib, t), t))(next =>
      (next =!= lib).fold(Audit.record(next, t, Change.Housekept: Term[Change]), lib))

AccessRequests.chaseCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((requests = lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t)).map(r => chased(r, t)), outbox = lib.outbox ++ chaseNotices(lib, t)))
AccessRequests.chased = (r: Term[AccessRequest], t: Term[BigInt]) => (reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded).fold(r.copy((reminded = True)), r)

AccessRequests.chaseNotices = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.requests.filter(r => !isPending(r, t)).map(r => Notice(r.person, Subject[Subject.Lapsed](r))) ++
      lib.requests.filter(r => isPending(r, t) && reminderDue(r, t) && !r.reminded)
        .flatMap(r => lib.documents.filter(doc => doc.id === r.doc).map(doc => Notice(doc.owner, Subject[Subject.Reminder](r))))

Housekeeping.tidyCode = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt]) =>
    lib.copy((documents = lib.documents.filterNot(doc => gone(doc, t)),
      shares = lib.shares.filter(s => inForce(s, t) && !ofGone(lib, t, s)),
      invitations = lib.invitations.filter(i => isOpen(i, t))))

Housekeeping.ofGone = (lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], s: Term[Share]) =>
    lib.documents.exists(doc => gone(doc, t) && s.what === Target[Target.Doc](doc.id))

val invitationsAreOffers = Node.claim("InvitationsAreOffers",
  "An invitation is an offer from someone who may edit: only they send it or take it back, it gives nobody access, it is taken up only by the person invited while it is open, and housekeeping clears it away within one of its periods of its lapsing.",
  why = "Q7: an invitation is how someone gets a share they have not asked for; it is a share offered, not given, so until it is accepted access is as before. Whether it is open is left open here (Lifetimes); that a lapsed one does not linger is what InvitationsLapseOnTime says with the clock.",
  idea = "Invitations"
)(forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], by: Term[PersonId], to: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
  (withdraw(lib, t, by, to, what) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
  forall((level: Term[Level]) => (invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level) =!= lib ==> mayEdit(lib, t, by, what)) &&
    forall((p: Term[PersonId], d: Term[DocumentId]) =>
      Sharing.access(invite(lib, t, by, to, what, level), t, p, d) === Sharing.access(lib, t, p, d)))) &&
  forall((lib: Term[Library], t: Term[BigInt], p: Term[PersonId], what: Term[Target]) =>
    accept(lib, t, p, what) =!= lib ==> lib.invitations.exists(i => i.to === p && i.what === what && isOpen(i, t))) &&
  after(events).library.invitations.forall(i => isOpen(i, after(events).now - housekeepingWithin)))
  .under(accessFollowsShares)
content.idea:
## Invitations

Anyone who can edit a document or folder can invite a person to it, at a level,
and withdraw the invitation. An invitation gives no access until the person
accepts it; accepting it makes the share. An invitation can be accepted for 7
days after it is sent; then it lapses, and housekeeping removes it.

InvitationsLapseOnTime.reason: Q7 as a bounded response: 7 days and the housekeeping bound, under HousekeepingOnTime.

content.statement: While housekeeping runs at least every two minutes, no invitation stays pending longer than 7 days and two minutes after it was sent.
content.why: Q7: an invitation lapses after 7 days, and housekeeping removes it at its next run (HousekeepingOnTime).
